notes: Shepherded PR #765 to merge in two phases. Phase 1 (~1 apple): fixed the genuine CI blocker, a TS2540 typecheck error in tests/game/behavior-tree-ai.test.ts (assignment to readonly objective.shopRoomPos/spellQuestGiverPos), by reassigning the whole mutable objective via spread (no type weakening, rule #12); the NPC-overlap review concern was already fixed on the branch (generic resolveNpcSpawnPosition + occupiedTiles de-dup) and covered by the 10-seed distinct-tile test. Phase 2 (~2 more apples, unplanned): a rebase-prs bot rebase triggered a fresh copilot review pass posting 6 NEW threads. Addressed all: (1+2) two real NPC-stacking bugs in floorScenario.ts — resolveFreeNpcTileInRoom returned early when all interiorCells were occupied instead of falling through to the bounds/radius scan, and the resolveNpcSpawnPosition preferred-tile fallback ignored occupiedTiles; (3) a per-frame allocation in the MainGameScene interaction hot path — refactored findNearestNearbyNpc to iterate the npc map + position stores directly (no candidate array); (4) added a deterministic retreat threat-ignore test (endRetreat/ignoredEnemyUntilFrame); (5+6) disclosed the branch's combat-AI changes in the PR description + added a cross-system ADR (2026-07-05-floor1-welcome-bar-npc-consolidation.md, required because the diff spans src/engine + src/game). Under-estimated because the bot rebase's fresh review pass was not foreseeable at estimate time; the shepherd scope legitimately grew from a 1-line fix to a small multi-file change. verify:fast green (315 changed unit tests); VERIFY_FULL Headless Floor 1 Gate re-validated win-rate (no seed bending, rule #13). A code-review subagent pass was run on the diff as a proportionate quality gate. Phase 3 (~0.5 apple): a further bot rebase spawned two more threads — corrected the apple-calibration field (hello_kitties to actual/5) and a PR-description-scope note. Phase 4 (~1 apple): a final copilot pass flagged that the ranged-preemption test at behavior-tree-ai.test.ts was VACUOUS (it set the close enemy as nearest, so findNearestEnemy picked it directly and the preemption branch — which only fires when the primary target is beyond contactThreatRadius — never executed); rewrote it to drive the progress-enemy path (far quest enemy stays the primary targetEid while a close non-quest threat inside contactThreatRadius redirects movement), and PROVED it non-vacuous by temporarily disabling the preemption block (test fails: reason becomes 'Closing to ranged standoff ... from 30.0ft' instead of orbiting). Also resolved two origin/main merge conflicts during the shepherd window (PR #764 spawner battle arena — trivial reset-field union in bt-ai-provider.ts; PR #775 labs fix — clean), re-validating typecheck + verify:fast + targeted tests after each.
